title: Mixed-attribution grant reports can drop the change obligation for edits made before the first check, silently
outcome: When mixed attribution suppresses a grant's first change observation, the suppression is recorded visibly (an unassigned observation or a host diagnostic naming the check), so a possibly missing change obligation can be seen until Engram's producer contract for observed turns can represent it.
acceptance: Mixed-attribution grant reports can drop the change obligation for edits made before the first check, silently is done
